description: Batch pacs.008 message with multiple credit transfer transaction information (CdtTrfTxInf) entries. Demonstrates how a single pacs.008 message can contain multiple individual payments from the same debtor to different creditors.
test_coverage: Group header NbOfTxs field validation (must equal 3)
Group header TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt validation (must equal sum of individual amounts: 5000.00 + 8250.25 + 2500.25 = 15750.50)
Different creditor accounts (3 different French IBANs)
Unique payment identifiers for each transaction (InstrId, EndToEndId)
business_rules_expected_to_pass: PACS008-AM01: All IntrBkSttlmAmt values must be positive
PACS008-AM02: Currency decimal places valid for all transactions
PACS008-DT01: Settlement date not in past
PACS008-CY01: Valid ISO 4217 currency code (EUR) for all transactions
PACS008-BC02: Valid instructing agent BIC
PACS008-BC03: Valid instructed agent BIC
PACS008-BC04: Valid debtor agent BIC for all transactions
PACS008-BC05: Valid creditor agent BIC for all transactions
PACS008-IB01: Valid debtor IBAN
PACS008-IB02: Valid creditor IBANs (3 different French IBANs)
PACS008-PT01: Debtor name present for all transactions
PACS008-PT03: Creditor name present for all transactions
PACS008-PT02: Debtor account present for all transactions
PACS008-PT04: Creditor account present for all transactions
PACS008-RF01: End-to-end ID present for all transactions
PACS008-RF02: Instruction ID present for all transactions
PACS008-CH01: Valid charge bearer code for all transactions
PACS008-CH02: SEPA requires shared charges (all use SHAR)
PACS008-SP01: SEPA requires EUR currency
PACS008-SP03: SEPA zone BICs
PACS008-SM01: Valid settlement method
PACS008-GH01: Message ID present
PACS008-GH02: Transaction count matches (NbOfTxs=3)
PACS008-GH03: Total settlement amount matches sum (15750.50)

batch_specific_attributes.debtor_consistency: Same debtor (Global Exports GmbH) for all transactions
batch_specific_attributes.creditor_variety: Three different creditors (Supplier Alpha, Beta, Gamma)
batch_specific_attributes.payment_batching: Single pacs.008 message containing 3 individual payments

notes: This demonstrates the batch capability of pacs.008.001.10. Unlike MT103 which is always single transaction, pacs.008 can contain multiple CdtTrfTxInf entries in a single message. This is particularly useful for corporate treasury operations making multiple payments to different suppliers. The GrpHdr contains totals (NbOfTxs=3, TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt=15750.50) that must match the individual transaction details. All three transactions share the same debtor account (common for payment batches) but have different creditors and amounts.
